observations: A large industrial water filtration or purification unit wrapped in plastic film.
The unit has a stainless steel control panel on the left with a digital display, red and green buttons, two gauges, and a yellow warning label.
Three large green cylindrical tanks are visible on the right, each with a blue label containing Chinese characters and a '24' symbol.
The tanks are mounted on a metal frame with wheels.
The unit is indoors, possibly in a warehouse or workshop, with a concrete wall and corrugated roof visible in the background.
The Chinese text on the green tanks appears to indicate different stages of filtration: '精密过滤器' (precision filter), '活性炭过滤器' (activated carbon filter), and '离子交换树脂' (ion exchange resin).
